title: Reword the stale ENGRAM_BIND_COLLISION_PHRASE doc comment now that a typed flag decides the transcript notice
outcome: The doc comment on ENGRAM_BIND_COLLISION_PHRASE in src/engram_verification_bind.rs describes the phrase only as the wording of the collision line. It says the typed EngramOwedBindSettled.collision flag in apply_engram_owed_binds decides which settled entries also get a durable transcript notice. It no longer says a line containing the phrase is written to the transcript.
acceptance: Reword the stale ENGRAM_BIND_COLLISION_PHRASE doc comment now that a typed flag decides the transcript notice is done
